mapper.select: SELECT , d.book_id AS detail_book_id, d.isbn AS detail_isbn, d.language AS detail_language, d.summary AS detail_summary, d.page_count AS detail_page_count FROM book b LEFT JOIN book_detail d ON d.book_id = b.book_id WHERE b.book_id = #{bookId} AND b.deleted = 0

SELECT , a.author_id, a.name AS author_name, a.country AS author_country, a.birth_date AS author_birth_date FROM book b LEFT JOIN book_author ba ON ba.book_id = b.book_id LEFT JOIN author a ON a.author_id = ba.author_id WHERE b.book_id = #{bookId} AND b.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.author_id
